Name: Tree Transplant Redux
Author: pacas
Description:
[b][size=5]Tree Transplant Redux[/size][/b]
[b]Tree Transplant Redux [/b]is a mod that lets you transplant trees / fruit trees (including modded ones)
on your farm without needing to chop them down and wait for them to regrow.
Please consider giving a like to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1342?tab=description]original mod[/url].

[size=4][b]Install: [/b][/size]
1. Install the [url=http://canimod.com/for-players/install-smapi][/url][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]latest version of SMAPI[/url]
2. Download the newest version from Nexus or [url=https://github.com/pacas/TreeTransplant]Github [/url]and install.

[size=4][b]Use: [/b][/size]
In order to transplant trees on your farm, you need to visit Robin the carpenter and select the "Tree Transplant" option in the menu.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/73XD75j.png[/img]

Once you're in the tree transplant menu it's simple to start moving your trees.

First, left-click on the tree you wish to move to highlight it.  By left-clicking again you can move the tree to a new location.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1SEXmce.png[/img]

A tree can only be relocated when all of the surrounding tiles are green,
if they are red that means there is a collision with another object such as a rock or building.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ORsqWhq.png[/img]

Certain trees also have different requirements for growth like this sapling which needs all surrounding tiles to be clear in order to grow.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MZae98V.png[/img]

By right-clicking with a tree selected or using the flip button in the bottom right corner you can flip the tree around for trees that support it.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4OTq4ll.png[/img]

Using the close button the bottom right or hitting your exit key on your keyboard (default escape)
you can close out of this menu and return back in front of Robin.

[size=4][b]Differences from the original: [/b][/size]

- Trees are previewed with the game's own drawing code, so trees from other mods work. The original had the vanilla tree sprites hard-coded.
- Robin's vanilla menu is no longer rebuilt by the mod; the extra option is added to the menu the game shows, so
  options added by other mods are kept.
- Grass no longer blocks a tree from being placed on its tile (it is replaced).
- The map view starts centered on the farmhouse.
